texts.zh: 与其他种群共生并非易事。在[Root.GetName]星上，由于无法让外星人合理融入我方社会，一些不和悄然形成。如果仍然不采取行动，或许会产生危机。
texts.en: Having our own species living together with other lifeforms isn't always easy. Some friction has begun to take form on [Root.GetName], surely due to our inability to incorporate the aliens into our society properly. If nothing is done they might be at risk.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上，我们的种群和混居的其他种群产生了不和。具体原因未知，可能是因为文化区别、自我封闭或者单单的误解。但很明显，若是放任不管，这些小型冲突就会愈演愈烈。
texts.en: Having other species living with our people has caused some friction on [Root.GetName]. Be it cultural differences, xenophobia or a common misunderstanding is hard to tell, but what is sure is that these small encounters could turn to the worse if we do not intervene.

summary.text:
# 种群隔阂 / What Separates Us

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/colony_events_2.txt:2652-2780

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2岁（15/958）或3岁（10/739）时的随机事件：非意识集合体帝国，殖民地上同时有非本族且未被奴役的非机器人口和本族排外人口。
  Random colony event at age 2 (15/958) or 3 (10/739): a non-Gestalt-Consciousness empire whose colony has both unenslaved non-robotic foreign pops and xenophobe pops of the main species.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「分歧所在」：本族排外居民与异族移民发生摩擦。选项随帝国立场分为中立/排外/亲外三版（给予移民保护修正与影响力奖励，排外人口愤怒720天）。
  "What Separates Us": xenophobe locals clash with foreign immigrants. The options come in neutral / xenophobe / xenophile versions (immigrant-protection modifier and an influence reward; xenophobe pops angered for 720 days).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
